shortDescription: Persist an exact immutable mapping as Ansible Vault ciphertext

options.name: document
options.description: Exact mapping to encrypt or validate. Keys must be strings. Values may contain only JSON-safe scalars, mappings, and lists. The task must set C(no_log=true); the action fails closed before inspecting this value otherwise.

options.name: path
options.description: Normalized absolute controller-local path of the encrypted document.

options.name: vault_id
options.description: Loaded Ansible Vault identity label to use when creating an absent document. The label may contain only ASCII letters, digits, dots, underscores, and hyphens. The action never accepts or loads Vault password material. Existing documents are validated with the identities already loaded by Ansible.
